title: Phase-4 evidence matching omits selected run and workload identity
title_de: Phase-4-Evidence-Matching lässt ausgewählte Run- und Workload-Identität aus
summary: The Phase-4 lifecycle checker accepted event records based only on rule ID and phase. Copied events carrying a foreign run ID, connector, or profile passed the same first-byte and no-full-buffer checks as a legitimate Apache event.
summary_de: Der Phase-4-Lifecycle-Checker akzeptierte Event-Records nur anhand von Rule-ID und Phase. Kopierte Events mit fremder Run-ID, fremdem Connector oder fremdem Profil bestanden dieselben First-Byte- und No-Full-Buffer-Checks wie ein legitimes Apache-Event.
observed_behavior: `matching_events` at lines 154-155 does not bind run ID, connector, host profile, integration mode, or transaction identity. Three temporary foreign-identity variants and one legitimate control all returned PASS for first-byte and no-full-buffer checks.
observed_behavior_de: `matching_events` in Zeilen 154-155 bindet weder Run-ID, Connector, Host-Profil, Integrationsmodus noch Transaktionsidentität. Drei temporäre Varianten mit fremder Identität und ein legitimer Kontrollfall lieferten alle PASS für First-Byte- und No-Full-Buffer-Checks.
expected_behavior: Each promoted Phase-4 event must bind the selected run ID, connector, host profile, integration mode, and transaction identity using the canonical event/result schema. Missing or mismatched identity fails closed.
expected_behavior_de: Jedes promotete Phase-4-Event muss mit dem kanonischen Event-/Result-Schema die ausgewählte Run-ID, den Connector, das Host-Profil, den Integrationsmodus und die Transaktionsidentität binden. Fehlende oder nicht passende Identität scheitert geschlossen.
impact: Evidence copied from another run, connector, or profile can be promoted as proof for a selected workload, breaking run identity and integration-mode integrity.
impact_de: Evidence, die aus einem anderen Run, Connector oder Profil kopiert wurde, kann als Nachweis für einen ausgewählten Workload promoted werden und verletzt Run-Identity- und Integrationsmodus-Integrität.
preconditions: A selected evidence directory contains a syntactically valid Phase-4 event with the expected rule and phase.
The event originates from a foreign run, connector, profile, or integration mode.
reproduction: Build temporary evidence roots containing an Apache selected-run result and a foreign-run event, foreign-connector event, or foreign-profile event.
Run `check-full-lifecycle-evidence.py` for first-byte and no-full-buffer with `--run-id selected-run --connectors apache`.
Observe PASS for every foreign variant and for the legitimate control.

evidence.command: GitHub exact-head check-runs, CodeQL/code-scanning, SonarCloud, review-thread, and scoped-diff inspection for PR #57

RTK-proxied detached exact-master inspection, diff/giltink comparison, and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 Parent unittest run for tests.test_full_lifecycle_gate_wiring, tests.test_full_lifecycle_evidence, and tests.test_six_connector_core_completion

root_cause: The event predicate used only rule ID and phase and was not initially invoked by the actual Parent first-byte/no-full-buffer/promotion Make targets. A stronger identity matcher existed in the six-connector completion checker but was not reused or wired into promotion.
root_cause_de: Das Event-Prädikat verwendete nur Rule-ID und Phase und wurde anfangs nicht von den tatsächlichen Parent-Make-Targets für First-Byte/No-Full-Buffer/Promotion aufgerufen. Ein stärkerer Identity-Matcher existierte im Six-Connector-Completion-Checker, wurde aber weder wiederverwendet noch in die Promotion verdrahtet.
proposed_remediation: Reuse the canonical identity-matching pattern, require all selected identity fields before promotion, and wire the Parent first-byte/no-full-buffer/promotion targets to the matching Parent checks. Add the named foreign-identity fixtures, a legitimate control, and a static target-wiring contract.
proposed_remediation_de: Das kanonische Identity-Matching-Muster wiederverwenden, vor Promotion alle ausgewählten Identitätsfelder verlangen und die Parent-Targets für First-Byte/No-Full-Buffer/Promotion mit den passenden Parent-Checks verdrahten. Die genannten Foreign-Identity-Fixtures, eine legitime Kontrolle und einen statischen Target-Wiring-Contract ergänzen.
acceptance_criteria: Foreign run-ID, connector, profile, and integration-mode events cannot satisfy first-byte or no-full-buffer checks.
Missing required event identity fails closed.
A legitimate event and result from the selected run remain accepted.
Result, event, manifest, and checksum identity are checked consistently without a filename/PASS-only decision.
The actual Parent first-byte, no-full-buffer, and promotion Make targets invoke their matching Parent identity checks.
validation_plan: Add the named foreign-identity and valid-control fixtures before the implementation change.
Rerun the original copied-event PoCs, an alternate missing-identity case, and the valid control after the fix.
Run focused lifecycle-evidence tests, a static Makefile target-wiring contract, and the applicable runtime-harness contract tests.
regression_tests: Focused check-full-lifecycle-evidence tests for run, connector, profile, and integration-mode mismatch.
Existing six-connector identity matcher control tests.
legitimate_control_tests: A selected Apache run with an identity-consistent native event passes first-byte and no-full-buffer checks.
A complete manifest chain with matching event/result identity remains accepted.
residual_risk: The exact Parent master fde2e02a1cf2226f8e9106e663e05e9b2941357e reproduces the original and alternate copied/missing identity cases as fail-closed and preserves the selected Apache legitimate control; FND-PARENT-0027 is verified, not closed. FND-CROSS-0006 is separately verified and FND-CROSS-0001 remains a distinct runtime-evidence limitation. The independent Parent Sonar release blocker FND-SONAR-0001 prevents aggregate master_integration_complete but does not reopen this verified Phase-4 identity repair.
residual_risk_de: Der exakte Parent-Master fde2e02a1cf2226f8e9106e663e05e9b2941357e reproduziert die ursprünglichen und alternativen kopierten/fehlenden Identity-Fälle fail closed und bewahrt die legitime ausgewählte Apache-Kontrolle; FND-PARENT-0027 ist verified, nicht closed. FND-CROSS-0006 ist separat verified und FND-CROSS-0001 bleibt eine eigenständige Runtime-Evidence-Grenze. Der unabhängige Parent-Sonar-Release-Blocker FND-SONAR-0001 verhindert aggregate master_integration_complete, eröffnet diese verifizierte Phase-4-Identity-Reparatur aber nicht erneut.

history.detail: Foreign run, connector, and profile event variants passed the selected Apache Phase-4 checks alongside the legitimate control.

Independent review found that the initial identity matcher was not wired into actual Parent promotion targets. Follow-up 0124b0d wired first-byte, no-full-buffer, and promotion checks, passed 20 focused tests and 33 PR checks, and received a clean re-review. FND-CROSS-0006 records the separate Framework-authoritative boundary.

Exact PR #57 head 5f8949b1d98a98127b933e9f1d626b30e3291b59 passed 33 success and 6 expected-skipped checks, strict ruleset contexts, CodeQL, SonarCloud, zero-open-alert query, review-thread inspection, focused documentation validation, and final scoped diff review. It remains fixed pending authorized merge and resulting-master original reproduction.
